svg.text: Enterprise technology capability model — what a complete IT estate has to answer for
The everyday working surface for corporate and frontline
staff, and the content it produces.
Systems of record for finance, assets, workforce, supply
Building and operating software, whether internal
applications or a product sold to customers.
Assistive and autonomous capability layered over data,
Storing, governing, modelling and presenting information for operational and investor reporting.
Connecting systems and automating processes across application and organisational boundaries.
Establishing, governing and enforcing who and what may access which resources.
Provisioning, configuring, securing and retiring the device estate across corporate and frontline populations.
Transport, segmentation and secure reachability between users, sites, workloads and assets.
Compute, storage, hosting topology and the automation and resilience standards applied to them.
The processes and tooling by which technology services are delivered and supported.
Each capability is sized as a single product-selection decision and mapped to its Microsoft first-party answer with a coverage rating, named alternatives and a Microsoft Learn reference.
Created with the assistance of Microsoft Scout, which uses AI — verify anything you intend to rely on for a decision. Capability model and platform mapping current as at August 2026.
